properties.note: DRAFT clip polygon covering Seattle + the Eastside (Mercer Island, Bellevue/Redmond as far as the Sammamish River Trail) + Lake Washington + Shoreline/Lake Forest Park to the north. Every vertex lies within the Seattle bounds guard (lat 47.0-48.0, lon -122.6..-121.8). This is the QUERY/CLIP boundary, not the routing extent — a self-hosted ORS/Valhalla graph must cover the bbox of ALL stored route geometry, which can extend beyond this polygon. Verify against the chosen canon ride extents before a production run.
